milestone: M36 Headless Autonomous Finalization Action Routing

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Existing headless.run.drive can record a bounded finalization route for a complete runtime-owned closure.
Finalization is authorized and validated in Rust, not inferred by the VSIX or caller.
Finalization writes bounded replay-safe evidence and a checkpoint without raw ledger payloads.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.run.drive can record and replay one authorized completion_finalization for a complete closure with a matching closure fingerprint.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M35.1 classifies drive closure but does not durably record that the runtime accepted completion finalization.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: External scheduled callers must keep finalization idempotence outside Brownie after observing a complete closure.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M33 routed parent joins, M34 exposed route candidates, and M35 classified closure; M36.1 consumes the complete closure into a durable finalization route.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive params/result are extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. completion_finalization is bounded execution result and ledger evidence, not a report/history/digest/readiness wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates finalization authorization, expected closure fingerprint, complete status, route absence, and writes or replays finalization evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless controller can safely close a completed run after a runtime-owned finalization route instead of relying on caller-side response memory.
answers.milestone_progress: This is the first M36 vertical slice and may make M36 closeout-eligible after CI and review.

exit_criteria: A complete closure with matching fingerprint records completion_finalization.
Replay returns the same completion_finalization without duplicate finalization ledger events.

Missing authorization, missing or mismatched fingerprint, routed explicit action, budget exhaustion, stale/no-progress, task-in-progress, no-eligible, and unknown nonterminal closures cannot record completion finalization.
VSIX validators accept valid finalization payloads and reject malformed fingerprints and raw fields.
No new RPC or wrapper surface is added.
